content.title: Where to watch the Detroit Pistons vs. Philadelphia 76ers for free tonight
content.text: Philadelphia 76ers guard Tyrese Maxey, left, drives against Detroit Pistons forward Paul Reed during the first half of an NBA Cup basketball game Friday, Nov. 14, 2025, in Detroit. (AP Photo/Ryan Sun)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe Detroit Pistons will travel to Xfinity Mobile Arena tonight for a matchup with the Philadelphia 76ers.Fans can catch the action on FanDuel Sports Network Detroit at 7 p.m. ET, with streaming options available through Fubo and DirecTV Stream. First-month discounts and free trials are available for new customers through both services.Detroit Pistons Streaming OptionsThe Pistons continue to lead the Eastern Conference with a 56-21 record. They’re coming off back-to-back victories against the Toronto Raptors and the Minnesota Timberwolves and will be looking to extend that winning streak with the playoffs on the horizon.The 76ers are in sixth place in the Eastern Conference with a 43-34 record. They’re also looking to build off the momentum from their back-to-back wins against the Washington Wizards and the Minnesota Timberwolves.
